description: Change begins with us—with the families, workers, and neighbors who make this district home. I’m running for Congress to fight for what matters most. Safer communities, lower costs of living and energy, real housing solutions, and protection for our most vulnerable. Share this site to help rally support for the solutions our families need. Stephanie Vargas for Congress, CA-D33
